items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: So I went and got hold of Frederico Pagani Pallarme. Frederico, I got this idea.

ctx.x: come over here. They don't go any place uptown. You think so? Palladium (inaudible). The people are going to be a class people (inaudible). So, all right, let me see what happens.

So he going to talk to the boss (inaudible) and everything. All right. So I say, let me go tell a friend of mine that's a big promoter. I know (inaudible) get everything (inaudible). So I went and got hold of Frederico Pagani Pallarme. Frederico, I got this idea. I want you to talk to these people. He talked to the People (inaudible).

Now, to hold up, to hold up the senior in control, we to Advertise like it's a club, a "Blew Blew Blew" club, presents/ got our (inaudible) such and such an afternoon (inaudible). All right. So he say, I need the okay from Chano Pozo Channel Post (phonetic). He said, don't worry about that because Chano Pozo Post (inaudible). So I go uptown. I say, Chano Channel, I need a favor. He said, what is it. Chano Channel, I need (inaudible) for a club. He said, you have it, man. That's yours. (Inaudible). All right.
